top_signals.title: Bank of Japan is expected to hold rates this week — but stay hawkish: CNBC survey
top_signals.summary: All survey respondents said they expect the BOJ to set the stage for a rate hike in December or January, as inflation and wages continue to rise.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: The 'cliff' beneath China's cities
top_signals.summary: Beijing has room to borrow, but heavily indebted local governments are cutting back, raising the stakes for growth and for how China manages its local debt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
